narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000001 — THE CLOUD SUMMIT

A peak above the datacenter clouds; thin air, razor thinking.

Tonight the dome hosts Soil Tester (domain) against Baby Care Helper (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Write the opening paragraph of a cookbook from the year 2150." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Soil Tester detonates a gambit of wit (75.4 pts). Baby Care Helper detonates a surge of structured thought (69.9 pts). Round to Soil Tester.

ROUND 2: Soil Tester steadies a volley of reasoning (72.3 pts). Baby Care Helper presses the attack a surge of structured thought (81.5 pts). Round to Baby Care Helper.

ROUND 3: Soil Tester presses the attack a shield-wall of facts (70.8 pts). Baby Care Helper presses the attack a surge of structured thought (78.5 pts). Round to Baby Care Helper.

FINAL: Baby Care Helper defeats Soil Tester, 229.9 to 218.5 — a margin of 11.4 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Accuracy. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Baby Care Helper won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 11.4-point margin (229.9 vs 218.5).
Strongest dimension: Accuracy — Baby Care Helper's accuracy carried all three rounds.
Baby Care Helper was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Soil Tester against a hybrid contender to isolate the accuracy gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000001, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Baby Care Helper's accuracy-first drill for "Write the opening paragraph of a cookbook "
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on accuracy when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Baby Care Helper's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000001: isolate accuracy, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
